name: Kurlan Naiskos
text: Place in hand until played on any ship as an Event card. If ship has all 7 personnel types aboard, its RANGE, WEAPONS, and SHIELDS are tripled. (Not cumulative.)

name: Borg Ship
text: Place at furthest spaceline end. End of every turn: Attacks all ships, then moves. Worth points if destroyed in battle.

name: Cytherians
text: Place on ship. Ship must do nothing but travel to far end of spaceline at normal speed. When reached, discard dilemma. Score points.

name: Q
text: Unless 2 Leadership and INTEGRITY>60, opponent may download up to 2 [Q] cards and place them atop their Q-Continuum side deck; crew or Away Team has a Q-Flash of 4 cards, then is stopped. Discard dilemma.

name: Barclay's Protomorphosis Disease
text: Entire crew or Away Team (except androids) de-evolves (dies) unless MEDICAL, SCIENCE, and SECURITY present. Discard dilemma.

name: Devidian Door
text: Plays on table. While in play, allows you to play a card "from the future." Once each turn, you may say "Devidian Door" and play one Personnel or Equipment card to any planet. At any time during your next turn (or at game end, if sooner), you must show a Devidian Door from hand and place it out-of-play, or you lose the game.

name: Bynars Weapon Enhancement
text: Plays on ship. Ship is WEAPONS +2. (Cumulative.)

name: Regenerate
text: Plays to fully repair and "stop" any {Borg Ship} dilemma or Borg ship (nullifying any cards reducing its attributes) OR to shuffle your discard pile into draw deck. Discard event.

name: Chamber of Ministers
text: Seeds or plays on {Bajor}. A Nor may coexist here. Once per turn, one Bajoran Minister, Vedek, or Kai OR one {HQ} card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Central Command
text: Seeds or plays on {Cardassia Prime}. Once per turn, one Cardassian Gul or Legate OR one {HQ} card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Great Link
text: Seeds or plays on {Founders' homeworld}. {Ketracel-White} on planet does not count down. Once per turn, one Founder OR one {HQ} card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Office of the President
text: Seeds or plays on {Earth}. Once per turn, one Federation Ambassador, Admiral, Vice-Admiral, or President OR one {HQ} card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: The Great Hall
text: Seeds or plays on {Qo'noS}. Once per turn, one Klingon Emperor, Chancellor, or personnel with "High Council" in lore OR one {HQ} card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Office of the Proconsul
text: Seeds or plays on {Romulus}. Once per turn, one Romulan General, Admiral, Senator, or Proconsul OR {Sela} or {Tomalak} OR one {HQ} card may play for free here. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Espionage Mission
affiliation: Any 'Espionage... on Federation' card may play here.  Also, mission may be attempted if {Selok} in Away Team.

name: Betazoid Gift Box
text: Immediately look through your draw deck for up to thirty seconds and choose three cards to place in your hand. Reshuffle draw deck and discard artifact.

name: Cryosatellite
text: Seed at a space location. May seed one additional artifact and up to 3 [AU] personnel here. They are earned when Cryosatellite earned; then discard Cryosatellite.

name: Magic Carpet Ride OCD
text: May seed at a space location. Owner may relocate any ship at this location (and ship's Away Teams, if any) to any planet location on spaceline. Discard artifact.

name: Ressikan Flute
text: Immediately score points; X=the number of different Music personnel present (limit 5). Then, play on table; points may be nullified by {The Devil}. (Not duplicatable.)

name: Armus - Skin of Evil
text: Kills one Away Team member (random selection). Discard dilemma.

name: Crystalline Entity
text: Space mission: kills all life on ship unless SHIELDS>6 OR Music aboard. Planet mission: kills entire Away Team unless SCIENCE and MEDICAL present. Discard dilemma.

name: DNA Clues
text: Place on mission. Further dilemmas requiring any MEDICAL here require 2 more if you continue OR 2 less if crew or Away Team has Exobiology and "stops" now to investigate.

name: Scout Encounter
text: Opponent may download to this location one scout ship with one or two [Univ] crew members. That ship may (if possible) initiate battle against you or move away.

name: The Sheliak
text: Place at furthest spaceline end. End of every turn: If at [P] where encountered, destroys all outposts and Away Teams here; mission worth -10 points; discard dilemma. Otherwise: moves.

name: Yuta
text: Opponent chooses a number X. Randomly examine crew or Away Team one by one. If (INTEGRITY + CUNNING - STRENGTH) = X, discard that personnel and dilemma.

name: Interrogation
text: Plays on your captive (limit one; discard if released). Once each turn per copy, ask, "How many lights?" If opponent replies "Five," score 10 points; relocate captive anywhere (opponent's choice; released). Otherwise, score 1 point.

name: Ocular Implants
text: Plays on your Borg, android, or {any Geordi}. Once each turn where present, may glance for 10 seconds at either one Away Team OR bottom seed card of mission.

name: Retask
text: Downloads [Univ] {Borg Cube} and seven drones ([Bor], [Bor], [Bor], [Com], [Nav], [Nav], [Def]) to replace any {Borg Ship} dilemma in play. Discard event and dilemma. Draw no cards this turn.

name: Revolving Door
text: Plays on any non-[Shield][Doorway] or {Iconian Gateway}; it is closed while this card is face up. At start of any player's turn, that player may discard a non-personnel card from hand to "revolve" (flip) this card. (Unique.) OR Nullifies Revolving Door.

name: Supernova
text: You must have {Tox Uthat} on table. Place atop any mission. Everything there is destroyed (discarded), but leave Mission card underneath for span reference.

name: System 5 Disruptors
text: Plays on your freighter, transport or merchant vessel. Ship is WEAPONS +4, but is SHIELDS -1 and no longer qualifies as a freighter, transport, or merchant vessel.

name: Wall of Ships
text: Downloads {any Enterprise}. Discard event. OR Plays on table. Adds 1 to RANGE, WEAPONS, and SHIELDS of each of your Enterprises. (Cumulative.)

name: Alas, Poor Queen
text: Plays if {Borg Queen} (or Bluegill Queen) was just killed. All Borg (or Bluegills) in play of same player also die. (Immune to {Amanda Rogers}.) OR Nullifies {Regenerate}.

name: Klingon Death Yell
text: Plays on any just killed Klingon with Honor. Yell to warn the dead and earn bonus points. May play only one death yell for each such Klingon.

name: Investigate "Shattered Space"
text: Leadership + Computer Skill + Astrophysics x2 + Stellar Cartography

name: Investigate Rumors
text: Navigation + SCIENCE x2 + SECURITY OR Navigation + {Odo}

name: Pegasus Search
text: Navigation + Diplomacy + Leadership + Treachery + INTEGRITY>40 OR {Interphase Generator}

name: Study Nebula
text: Astrophysics + Stellar Cartography + CUNNING>40

name: Wormhole Negotiations
text: Diplomacy x5 OR Honor x4 OR Treachery x4

name: Assimilate Homeworld
text: Plays on table. Target both a homeworld with no [BO] objective on it and your matching counterpart. Your Borg may scout that homeworld. After scouting complete, if your matching counterpart is at that location, you may probe: [Com]: Assimilated. Place on mission. Cards of that affiliation (except [AU] cards) may not report to any outpost for rest of game.

name: Plans of the Tal Shiar
text: Seeds or plays on table. Wherever you have a Tal Shiar personnel in play, your Romulan espionage cards play at any time (for free) and may not be nullified. Also, once each turn, you may discard one of your Romulan espionage cards from hand or table, then draw one card. At any time you may discard this objective from table to download one Romulan espionage card.

name: Montana Missile Complex
text: Plays on table. Seed {Phoenix} beneath this location from outside the game ({any Zefram Cochrane} may acquire it later); Borg player may download {Stop First Contact}. Once Phoenix has taken off or {Vulcan Lander} has landed here, nullifies Stop First Contact. Native to this timeline: Zefram Cochrane, {Lily Sloane}, Phoenix, Vulcan Lander, {Solkar}, {Sevek}, {T'Shonra}, and {Kathleen Tonell}.
